specification.status: Accepted alternate-history June 1982 availability target; engineering and manufacturing qualification required.
specification.dual_display: The 64 KiB card occupies the existing dedicated video slot; the 128 KiB professional card occupies one general 32-bit expansion slot. Independent framebuffers, clocks and palettes; freeze address windows, interrupts, DMA arbitration and power budget before release.
specification.layout: Colour display hosts commands/status; 800x600 monochrome display hosts the CAD canvas. Explicit display handles, coordinate transforms, keyboard/mouse focus and cursor ownership; no implicit shared framebuffer.
acceleration: Overlap-safe rectangular copies with stride and clipping
Rectangle fills and masked Boolean raster operations
Optional lookup-table antialiased line drawing with four output shades
specification.rendering: Keep vector geometry authoritative. CPU tessellates curves; redraw damaged regions and exposed pan strips. XOR is for temporary simple cursors, not erasing antialiased overlapping geometry. No full-frame 2bpp double buffer in 128 KiB.
specification.bandwidth: At 60 Hz visible framebuffer reads alone average 7.2 MB/s. Qualify banked/wide memory, line buffering, refresh priority and accelerator/host arbitration under worst-case drawing load.
specification.portability: Capability-query extension with software fallback for development on the existing display; later hardware accelerates the same semantics. CAD canvas requires explicit mouse adaptation.
